name: word_edit_table
description: Change a table's cells and structure: set cells by position or labels, insert or delete rows and columns, merge, split, sync rows by key. Returns it as Markdown.

row_label.description: Or the row's first cell text.

from.description: Or one value: d:<id>/#12/<column>, :0.0 to round.

rows.description: Or a column's rows: 1..40, or * (all but header rows).

from.description: set_cells, sync: rows of d:<id> or t:<table>, from row index.

from_columns.description: from's columns, in order (sync: per table column, default by labels). Default all.

key.description: sync: key column label or index. Default first.

remove.description: sync: delete rows of gone keys.

loose.description: sync: also match keys loosely (case, spacing, separators, 05=5); whose spelling stays.

header.description: from's header texts; [] none. Default column names.

date_format.description: Dates of from as e.g. d mmmm yyyy or dd/mm/yyyy.

index.description: insert_*, delete_*, copy_row: row or column from 0. Default the last. set_cells from: first row.

grow.description: set_cells from: add rows the data needs.

side.description: insert_*, copy_row: relative to index. Default after.
